title: testvol: return error in Path endpoint when volume is unmounted
body: This updates the `testvol` mock driver's `Path()` endpoint to verify if a volume is actually mounted before returning a path. If the volume has no active mounts, it now correctly returns an error instead of a fake path, resolving the existing TODO in `test/testvol/main.go`.
